description: Update the supplied settings of a Replo project: name, time zone, currency, support email, or checkoutProvider. Changing checkoutProvider affects checkout on the project's sites after publication; Shopify checkout requires a connected store and Replo checkout requires payments onboarding. Publishing is a separate action.
